svg.title: Stage-I model and preprocessing-preset performance heatmaps

cc:Work.dc:title: Stage-I model and preprocessing-preset performance heatmaps
cc:Work.dc:description: Four Stage-I heatmaps compare six preprocessing presets across 19 models, with per-preset marginal means and explicit unavailable cells.
